### Write(T, uint, PgMemoryContext)

Creates a checked result, optionally representing SQL NULL, without retaining the operation's context.

```csharp
PgDatum Write(T value, uint typeOid, PgMemoryContext destination)
```

Parameters:

`value` — <code>T</code>

The present managed value.

`typeOid` — [uint](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uint32)

The current exact PostgreSQL target type OID.

`destination` — [PgMemoryContext](/api/ankus.pgmemorycontext/)

The destination for native storage needed by this operation.

Returns: [PgDatum](/api/ankus.pgdatum/)

A live datum with exactly typeOid, including for SQL NULL; never a null handle.

Array element writers receive temporary storage that remains live through complete array construction.
Returning a checked datum owned elsewhere does not transfer or dispose its original owner.
